Early assessment can be important for accurate diagnosis and treatment planning, supported by tests such as MRI and EEG where needed. MedLuxLife coordinates consultations, investigations and follow-up at our partner hospital.
A detailed neurological examination by a paediatric neurologist, with MRI and EEG when considered necessary.
Monitoring and treatment of different seizure types and epilepsy in children.
Assessment of delays in motor skills such as walking, in speech and in cognitive development.
Care for muscle weakness, movement disorders and spinal muscular atrophy (SMA).
Management of inherited and congenital conditions affecting the nervous system.
Evaluation of headaches and fainting episodes in children.
Congenital diseases of the nervous system

How does the free consultation work?

Send us your enquiry via the contact form, by email or on WhatsApp. We will get back to you, talk through your wishes and explain the next steps. The first consultation is free of charge and non-binding.
Does MedLuxLife carry out medical treatments itself?

Where do the treatments take place?
At our partner hospital and partner clinics in Türkiye. We coordinate your appointments, accommodation and transfers so that you can concentrate on your treatment.

Plastic and aesthetic surgery can restore harmony and proportion to the face and body. MedLuxLife connects you with experienced plastic surgeons and plans every step of your stay, from the first consultation to your recovery, so you can make your decision calmly and with full information.
A combination of procedures that addresses changes after pregnancy and childbirth, tailored to your needs. It may include:
to remove excess skin and tighten the abdominal muscles
for stubborn fat on the abdomen, hips or thighs
Reshapes the nose to improve facial balance and, where needed, breathing.
changes size, tip shape or nostrils, or corrects asymmetry
improves breathing, for example with a deviated septum
Removes excess skin and fat from the abdomen and tightens the underlying muscles for a flatter, firmer contour.
an incision from hip to hip, often with repositioning of the navel
a shorter incision for minor excess below the navel
Reduces the size and weight of very large breasts. It can relieve back and neck pain, restricted movement and skin irritation, and creates a more balanced silhouette.
Male breast reduction removes excess glandular tissue and fat, using liposuction, direct excision or both, for a flatter, more masculine chest.
Removes loose skin and fat from the upper arms, often after major weight loss or with age, through an incision on the inner or back of the arm.
Fat is removed by liposuction from areas such as the abdomen or flanks, purified and transferred to the buttocks for more volume and a natural, lifted shape.
Removes excess skin and fat from the thighs and tightens the tissue for a smoother contour, typically after significant weight loss.

Corrects drooping upper eyelids and under-eye bags for a fresher, more youthful look. Upper eyelid surgery is usually done under local anaesthesia; lower eyelid surgery generally under general anaesthesia.
Reduces visible signs of ageing such as sagging skin and deep folds. Depending on your needs, the surgeon chooses a full, mini, mid-face or temporal lift.
Reduces the fat pads in the lower cheeks through small incisions inside the mouth, for more sculpted cheeks and a defined jawline. Usually performed under local anaesthesia.
Removes stubborn fat deposits that do not respond to diet and exercise, for example on the abdomen, thighs, arms, back or waist, to sculpt the body contour.
Lifts and reshapes sagging breasts for a firmer, more youthful position. It can be combined with augmentation to add volume at the same time.
Tightens loose skin and reshapes the neck and jawline. Often combined with a facelift for a harmonious result.

IV treatments deliver vitamins, minerals and other nutrients directly into the bloodstream, so they are fully available to the body. They are designed to support energy, regeneration and overall well-being, and every infusion is selected after a short medical assessment.
A classic infusion with vitamin C, B vitamins, magnesium and calcium to support energy, immunity and general well-being.
Nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide is a coenzyme involved in cellular energy production. The infusion is used to support energy, mental clarity and healthy ageing.
Supports stronger hair and nails and healthy hair growth, and nourishes the follicles, for example after a hair transplant.
Supports skin firmness, smoothness and moisture, promotes collagen production and complements facial mesotherapy.
With L-carnitine and other nutrients to support metabolism and fat burning as part of a weight-management programme.
High-dose vitamin C with antioxidant properties that supports the immune system, tissue regeneration and collagen production.
A strong antioxidant that helps to regenerate other antioxidants such as vitamins C and E and supports nerve health and metabolism.
Supports immune function, energy metabolism and antioxidant capacity.
Amino acids, vitamins and minerals that support collagen production, skin health and overall vitality.
A powerful antioxidant that supports the body’s natural detoxification and the immune system and helps protect cells from oxidative stress.
Plan your IV treatment with confidence

Hair transplantation moves healthy hair follicles from areas where hair is resistant to thinning, usually the back and sides of the head, to areas with thinning or hair loss. It is one of the most requested aesthetic procedures for men and women with pattern hair loss, and the results grow naturally with your own hair.

Before any treatment, an AI-supported digital analysis evaluates hair density and thickness, the health of individual follicles and whether they are in a growth or resting phase. This helps to choose the most suitable technique and to track your progress objectively over time.
Individual follicles are taken one by one from the donor area with a fine, circular micro-punch and implanted into the thinning areas. No linear scar, and a comfortable recovery.

For a fuller, more defined beard or moustache. Follicles, usually from the back of the head, are transplanted into sparse areas. An effective option for uneven growth, scarring or hair loss caused by genetics, hormones or injury.
Reshapes and strengthens thin, sparse or over-plucked eyebrows with your own hair follicles. A permanent, natural-looking alternative to make-up or microblading.

An advanced form of FUE in which the channels are opened with blades made of sapphire crystal instead of steel. The finer, sharper blades allow very precise incisions, with less tissue trauma and swelling.
Follicles are implanted directly with a special implanter pen (Choi pen), without opening channels in advance. This allows precise control of angle, direction and depth.

A strip of skin is taken from the donor area and divided into individual follicular units. FUT allows many grafts in one session but leaves a longer linear scar, so it is used today only in selected cases.

Not every case of thinning hair needs surgery. Restorative hair therapies nourish and stimulate the hair follicles, help to slow hair loss and improve hair density and quality. They can be used on their own or to support the results of a hair transplant.

Exosomes are tiny vesicles released by cells that carry proteins, lipids and growth signals. For hair restoration they are usually derived from mesenchymal stem cells and injected into thinning areas of the scalp, where they stimulate the follicles, extend the growth phase and support a healthier scalp. Exosomes are often combined with PRP.

A tailored blend of vitamins, amino acids, plant extracts and other active ingredients is injected into the scalp to nourish the hair follicles. Usually performed as a series of sessions; many patients notice thicker, stronger hair over time.
A motorised mesotherapy device delivers even micro-injections at a controlled depth, which makes the treatment quicker and more comfortable than manual injections.

A non-invasive, low-level light treatment at wavelengths of around 600 to 650 nanometres. The light is absorbed by the follicle cells, stimulates their energy production, improves local circulation and supports healthy hair growth.

A small amount of your own blood is processed in a centrifuge to obtain plasma rich in platelets. Injected into the scalp, it stimulates the hair follicles and supports cell renewal. PRP is a well-established option to reduce hair loss and improve hair density.
Plan your hair treatment with confidence

Bariatric (obesity) surgery can lead to substantial, lasting weight loss and improve weight-related health problems and quality of life. The right procedure depends on your health, your weight and your goals, and is chosen together with your surgeon.

Deciding on weight-loss surgery is a big step, and you do not have to take it alone. We take your health, your dignity and your well-being seriously and work with experienced teams who offer evidence-based treatment in a supportive, judgement-free setting.
Sleeve gastrectomy reduces the size of the stomach, which limits food intake and leads to significant, sustainable weight loss. One of the most widely performed weight-loss operations today.
The most common form, the Roux-en-Y gastric bypass, reduces food intake and limits calorie absorption by changing the route of the digestive tract. A proven option for long-term weight loss.
Plan your weight-loss treatment with confidence

A healthy, natural-looking smile supports both your well-being and your confidence. MedLuxLife connects you with experienced dental specialists who combine modern digital diagnostics with proven treatment methods, from a single implant to a complete smile makeover.
A complete smile makeover designed to create a bright, even and harmonious smile that suits your facial features. Depending on your needs, it can combine:
in porcelain or zirconium to correct discolouration, chips or minor misalignment
to repair small flaws or gaps

A permanent solution for missing or damaged teeth. A titanium or other biocompatible implant is placed in the jawbone, where it integrates over time and forms a stable base for a crown, bridge or denture.
Looks and feels like a natural tooth

Fixed full-arch solutions for patients who are missing most or all of their teeth. A complete set of upper or lower teeth is supported by four or six implants. In many cases temporary teeth can be fitted on the same day.
All-on-6 may be recommended where more stability is needed or bone loss is more advanced. Your dentist will advise which option suits you.
Aesthetic and functional solutions for missing teeth, including fixed crowns and bridges placed over natural teeth.
Fixed or removable prostheses attached to implants in the jawbone, offering better stability and comfort than conventional dentures.
A cosmetic treatment that lightens the colour of the teeth and removes stains and discolouration.
Custom-made restorations in zirconia ceramic that improve the shape and colour of your teeth while looking natural.
Very strong and resistant to chipping and staining
Suitable for patients who grind their teeth

Healthy teeth need healthy gums. Gum inflammation (gingivitis) and advanced gum disease (periodontitis) are treated with professional cleaning, scaling and root planing and, where necessary, surgical procedures to protect the gums and bone.
Repair of damaged or decayed teeth, for example with fillings, to restore their function, structure and appearance.
Cleaning and sealing the inflamed or damaged nerve tissue inside a tooth, so the natural tooth can be saved instead of extracted.

Injections into the masseter muscle can ease teeth grinding (bruxism) and jaw tension and give the lower face a slimmer, more oval contour. A quick treatment whose effect typically lasts 4 to 6 months.

Treatment of pain, clicking or locking of the jaw joint, which is often linked to teeth grinding. Night guards (splints) protect the joint and relax the muscles; surgical options are available where needed.
Braces and clear aligners correct crooked, crowded or gapped teeth. Options for all ages include metal or tooth-coloured brackets and discreet clear aligner systems.
Plan your dental treatment with confidence

Medical aesthetics offers non-surgical treatments to smooth lines, restore volume and refresh the skin, with little or no downtime. Treatments are carried out by qualified doctors and planned to keep your natural expression.
Medical uses include reducing excessive sweating (hyperhidrosis) and easing jaw tension related to teeth grinding.

Micro-injections deliver vitamins, minerals, amino acids and other nourishing substances directly into the skin, for skin rejuvenation, cellulite or localised fat. Several sessions give the best results; downtime is minimal.

Exosomes deliver growth factors and proteins to skin cells to support regeneration and collagen production. Applied after microneedling, laser or radiofrequency treatments, they help the skin recover and look brighter, firmer and smoother.
Plan your aesthetic treatment with confidence

Regular check-ups help healthy people stay healthy. Many conditions can be detected before they cause any symptoms, when treatment is often simpler and more effective. Our check-up packages are tailored to your age and the health needs of your stage of life and are carried out at partner hospitals.
Packages tailored to each stage of life:
The exact content of each package (laboratory tests, imaging and specialist consultations) is shared with you during your consultation, so you can choose the package that suits you best.

Cardiology covers the evaluation, diagnosis, treatment and follow-up of heart conditions. Our partner hospital’s cardiology department includes a cardiology outpatient clinic, a coronary intensive care unit, cardiac catheterisation and angiography laboratories, an electrophysiology unit and cardiology laboratories, and works closely with cardiovascular surgery.
Transthoracic and transoesophageal echocardiography to assess the structure and function of the heart.
Treadmill stress test, rhythm Holter, event recorder and tilt-table test.
Coronary angiography, haemodynamic studies and right and left heart catheterisation.
Percutaneous transluminal coronary angioplasty (PTCA) and intracoronary stent placement.
Implantation of permanent pacemakers and implantable cardioverter-defibrillators (ICD).
Electrophysiological studies and radiofrequency ablation to treat heart rhythm disorders.
Mitral and pulmonary balloon valvuloplasty to widen narrowed heart valves.
Percutaneous closure of atrial septal defects (ASD) and patent ductus arteriosus (PDA).
Septal ablation, pericardiocentesis and endomyocardial biopsy.
Previous ECGs, echocardiography or angiography reports
Plan your cardiology consultation with confidence

Cancer treatment is planned according to the type, stage and biological features of the disease and your personal situation. Through our partner hospital, your case is assessed by a multidisciplinary team in which medical oncologists work closely with surgeons, radiation oncologists and other specialists.
A treatment plan tailored to the type and stage of the disease, agreed in cooperation with surgery, radiation oncology and other departments.
Drug treatments that stop the growth of cancer cells or destroy them, planned individually.
Medicines that act on specific features of cancer cells, used where the tumour biology makes them suitable.
Treatments that help the immune system to recognise and fight cancer cells.
Used for hormone-sensitive cancers, such as some breast and prostate cancers.
Regular follow-up, management of side effects, preserving quality of life and psychosocial support during treatment.

Pathology report and, if available, tissue blocks or slides

Orthopaedics and traumatology deal with the diagnosis, treatment and rehabilitation of problems of the bones, joints, muscles and spine in adults and children, including injuries from daily life and sport. Our partner hospital combines experienced orthopaedic surgeons with robotic and navigation technology and works with physical therapy and rehabilitation for a quick return to daily life.
Closed (keyhole) surgery of the knee, shoulder, hip, ankle, elbow and wrist. Recovery is quick and in many cases no hospital stay is needed.
Joint replacement for arthritis performed with robotic technology, special navigation systems and computer assistance.
Joint prostheses for advanced joint wear, for pain-free movement.
Treatment of ligament, meniscus, tendon and cartilage injuries from sport.
Treatment of foot and ankle injuries and conditions.
Surgical treatment of shoulder injuries, instability and wear.
For extensive cartilage damage where other treatments have failed, to preserve the joint and prevent or delay the need for a prosthesis.
Treatment of spinal fractures, infections, tumours and congenital or acquired curvatures.
Treatment of fractures and injuries and their consequences.
Diagnosis and treatment of orthopaedic problems in children.
Diagnosis and treatment of bone and soft tissue tumours.
Plan your orthopaedic consultation with confidence

Neurosurgery covers the surgical diagnosis and treatment of diseases of the brain, spine, spinal cord and nerves. At our partner hospital’s neurological sciences centre, neurosurgeons work in a multidisciplinary team with neurologists, anaesthesiologists, intensive care specialists, radiologists, psychiatrists, psychologists and rehabilitation specialists, in specialised wards and intensive care units.
Microsurgical treatment of tumours of the brain, spinal cord and nerve sheaths, pituitary tumours and skull base tumours.
Treatment of aneurysms, subarachnoid haemorrhage, arteriovenous malformations of the brain and spinal cord and selected strokes, including bypass surgery for blocked brain vessels.
Surgical treatment of epilepsy by a specialised neurology and neurosurgery team, including epilepsy monitoring.
Surgery for lumbar and cervical disc herniation, age-related spinal stenosis and wear, spinal and spinal cord tumours and congenital disorders.
Spine-strengthening procedures for fractures caused by osteoporosis or tumour metastases.
Intrathecal drug pumps for spasticity and pain, and injection treatments for spine-related pain that does not need surgery.
Microsurgical treatment of carpal tunnel syndrome, ulnar and peroneal nerve compression, meralgia paraesthetica and nerve or plexus injuries.
Precise, image-guided procedures on the brain.
Treatment of injuries of the brain, spine and spinal cord.
Surgical treatment of brain and spine conditions in children.
Plan your neurosurgery consultation with confidence

We help you obtain a medical opinion, plan your treatment with partner hospitals and organise your travel and stay.
Diagnosis, second opinions and modern cancer treatment planned by multidisciplinary teams.
Heart check-ups, diagnostics and interventional procedures for heart and vascular conditions.
Joint replacement, arthroscopy, spine and sports injuries, with rehabilitation.
Fertility assessment and assisted reproduction with personal, discreet care.

Cataract, refractive (laser) surgery, retina and other eye treatments.
Kidney and liver transplantation, including living-donor programmes.

The wish to have a child is very personal. Our partner IVF centre plans every treatment individually, based on current scientific evidence, and its experienced team of physicians and embryologists decides together on each case. The causes of infertility are investigated carefully first, so that you are spared unnecessary treatment.
Medical history, ultrasound, hormone tests, semen analysis and, if needed, hysteroscopy for both partners.
Ovarian stimulation over about 8 to 14 days, egg collection under anaesthesia, fertilisation in the laboratory and a painless embryo transfer.
IVF in your natural cycle without stimulating medication, for example for women who respond poorly to medication or prefer not to use hormones.

The transplant clinic at our partner hospital brings these stages together under one roof, from diagnostic work-up and treatment planning to follow-up after discharge. MedLuxLife helps adult patients and their families arrange the evaluation with the specialists and stay well informed throughout a lengthy treatment journey.

Learning that kidney damage is permanent can be a difficult moment, and careful confirmation of the diagnosis comes first. The kidney transplant team at our partner hospital aims to protect kidney function for as long as possible and, where kidney failure reaches its final stage, assesses whether a transplant is a suitable option. MedLuxLife coordinates the evaluation for both recipient and donor, organises appointments and travel, and supports you through follow-up.

Endocrine surgery treats disorders of the hormone-producing glands, mainly the thyroid, parathyroid and adrenal glands, when too much or too little hormone is produced or when a growth needs removal. These delicate operations require careful technique to protect the voice, calcium balance and surrounding structures. MedLuxLife arranges your consultation with the surgical team at our partner hospital and plans your stay around surgery and recovery; hormone results and scans go directly to the doctors.

Thoracic surgery treats diseases of the organs and tissues within the chest, excluding the heart, including the lungs, airways, chest wall, pleura, diaphragm, mediastinum and oesophagus. The department uses fibreoptic and endoscopic equipment, minimally invasive surgical tools and imaging from virtual bronchoscopy to PET-CT, supported by pathology and laboratory services. MedLuxLife coordinates evaluation and surgery at our partner hospital, from your first consultation with the specialist to planning your recovery stay.

Gastroenterology covers the evaluation, diagnosis and treatment of diseases of the stomach, intestines, liver, bile ducts and pancreas. The department at our partner hospital offers a wide range of diagnostic and therapeutic endoscopy, alongside dedicated care for reflux, liver disease, inflammatory bowel disease and colorectal cancer screening. MedLuxLife helps you arrange procedures and understand preparation instructions; the hospital gives you your reports for your doctor at home.

Chest diseases, or pulmonology, covers the diagnosis, treatment and long-term follow-up of conditions affecting the lungs and airways. The department at our partner hospital serves adult patients through its outpatient clinic, bronchoscopy unit, pulmonary function laboratory and allergy skin testing. MedLuxLife coordinates your appointments; previous scans and lung function results go directly to the specialist, for example in your online consultation.

Childhood and adolescence are times of rapid physical, emotional and psychological change, and mental health concerns in these years need an assessment that takes development and family circumstances into account. The child and adolescent psychiatry department at our partner hospital offers assessment, follow-up and treatment programmes for emotional, behavioural and developmental difficulties. MedLuxLife helps families arrange consultations with the specialists and plan follow-up across borders.

The neonatal intensive care unit looks after premature babies and term newborns who need close monitoring and specialised treatment in their first weeks of life. MedLuxLife helps families coordinate admission to the NICU at our partner hospital, arrange transfers and keep in touch with the care team. We support parents with travel, accommodation and translation so they can focus on their baby.

Medical genetics diagnoses inherited and non-inherited conditions caused by changes in genes, and helps individuals and families understand their risks, including carrier status and risks for future children. The genetic diagnosis centre at our partner hospital offers genetic consultations and counselling alongside cytogenetic, molecular cytogenetic and molecular genetic testing in ISO 15189 accredited laboratories. MedLuxLife coordinates your appointments and the practical steps of your visit.

Medical imaging underpins the diagnosis and treatment planning of many conditions.
